title: Cyclic Photophosphorylation & Thylakoid Spatial Partitioning
topic: PS I Recycling, Stroma Lamellae vs Appressed Grana, & ATP-Only Synthesis
topics: Cyclic Photophosphorylation Mechanism (PS I -> Ferredoxin -> PQ Pool -> Cyt b6f -> PC -> P700)
Key Physiological Triggers (NADP+ Depletion, Elevated ATP/NADPH Ratio Demand)
Thylakoid Membrane Spatial Segregation: Appressed Grana (PS II + LHC II) vs Stroma Lamellae (PS I + ATP Synthase)
Absence of PS II and FNR in Stroma Lamellae
quickSummary: Cyclic photophosphorylation involves PS I (P700) alone. Excited electrons pass from Ferredoxin back to the Plastoquinone pool and Cytochrome b6f before returning to P700. It produces ATP ONLY, without NADPH or O2 evolution. Spatially, PS II is confined to appressed (stacked) grana thylakoids, whereas stroma lamellae and unstacked grana margins lack PS II and FNR, performing cyclic electron transport exclusively.

summaryBox.title: Quick Section Summary
summaryBox.takeaway: Cyclic uses PS I only, generates ATP only, evolves NO O2, and occurs in stroma lamellae where PS II and FNR are absent.

conceptBreakdown.content:
When $\text{NADP}^+$ is depleted or extra ATP is needed for the Calvin cycle, excited electrons from $\text{P700}^*$ pass to **Ferredoxin (Fd)**, but are redirected to the **Plastoquinone (PQ) pool $\rightarrow$ Cytochrome $b_6f \rightarrow$ Plastocyanin (PC) $\rightarrow$ back to $\text{P700}$**.
• Generates **$\text{ATP}$ ONLY** via proton pumping at Cytochrome $b_6f$.
• Produces **NO $\text{NADPH}$** and evolves **NO $\text{O}_2$** (water photolysis is absent).

conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
NON-CYCLIC vs CYCLIC PHOTOPHOSPHORYLATION
                     
   FEATURE                    NON-CYCLIC                     CYCLIC
   Photosystems Involved      PS II (P680) + PS I (P700)     PS I (P700) Only
   Membrane Location          Appressed Grana Thylakoids     Stroma Lamellae & Non-Appressed Grana
   Electron Donor             $\text{H}_2\text{O}$ (via OEC) None (Recycled internally)
   Final Electron Acceptor    $\text{NADP}^+$                P700 (PS I Reaction Center)
   Products Generated         $\text{ATP} + \text{NADPH} + \text{O}_2$  $\text{ATP}$ Only
conceptBreakdown.content:
• **Appressed Grana Thylakoids (Stacked Regions)**: Rich in PS II and Light-Harvesting Complex II (LHC II); site of water photolysis and non-cyclic electron transport.
• **Stroma Lamellae & Non-Appressed Grana Margins**: Contain PS I and $\text{CF}_0\text{--}\text{CF}_1$ ATP Synthase, but completely lack PS II and FNR, restricting them exclusively to **Cyclic Photophosphorylation**.
